name: Rotatable statue
description: A heavy stone statue the player turns in fixed steps with Interact (and can drag). Placed at yaw 0 it faces north; a quarter turn of the instance turns it east, south, west. A facing sensor per compass direction tells the puzzle which way it looks: a statue that must face the sunrise, a row of statues that must all look at the door.

stepAngle.description: Degrees one turn rotates it; 90 gives the four compass facings.

inputs.name: turn
inputs.description: Interact with the statue turns it by one step; a rotate spell or a shove with a rotate effect does the same.

outputs.name: facing-north
outputs.description: On while the statue faces north (+z).

outputs.name: facing-east
outputs.description: On while the statue faces east (+x).

outputs.name: facing-south
outputs.description: On while the statue faces south (-z).

outputs.name: facing-west
outputs.description: On while the statue faces west (-x).
